hypothesis: Disjoint penalized and unpenalized batch features produced substantially better attribution in iteration 2. Combining that exact basis with actual minimum-token masking state tests whether both sources of variation can be explained together.

pcvs.name: penalty_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Preserves the penalty feature used in the best-performing penalty fit.

pcvs.name: unpenalized_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Restores the disjoint batch features from iteration 2 so their fitted contributions remain specific to each branch.

pcvs.name: minimum_token_mask_entries
pcvs.rationale: Separates masked and unmasked unpenalized calls, which empty penalty histories could not distinguish.
